title: No-code alternative for your own trading bots
author: Snoo-47551
selftext:
Hey all ai vibers

If you work with writing and creating AI trading bots, you know the difficulty of

1. Having access to great data  
2. Avoiding execution issues such as look ahead bias.  
3. Hosting your own code.

I've faced the same issues in my bot building and that's why I built [https://www.premissai.com](https://www.premissai.com) 

It's essentially an agent harness for trading, you can research and iterate on trading ideas and when happy we'll even host the code 

It's early stage and for free but if you are into no-code plattforms, I think you'll find out Premiss to be very strong
